questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 的直接压电电荷系数与 PFM 有效位移响应在不同厚度和制备路线下能否直接比较？

source_candidates.title: Piezo-generated charge mapping revealed through direct piezoelectric force microscopy
source_candidates.independence_note: Primary direct-charge DPFM report on the 400 nm commercial BFO film.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Commercial 400 nm BiFeO3 film on platinum with oppositely written domains
source_candidates.method_scope: Direct piezoelectric force microscopy and integrated generated charge
source_candidates.reported_lead: Average direct d33 of 43 plus or minus 6 pC/N from two scan profiles.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: A direct charge coefficient cannot be silently merged with a converse PFM displacement-per-voltage response.

source_candidates.title: Thickness dependence of piezoelectric property of ultrathin BiFeO3 films
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent authors and film series using a converse PFM route.
source_candidates.sample_scope: BiFeO3 films from 1 to 150 nm on LSMO buffered SrTiO3 001
source_candidates.method_scope: Quantitative PFM response after upward and downward electrical poling
source_candidates.reported_lead: Effective d33 decreases from about 46 pm/V at 150 nm to about 8 pm/V at 6 nm.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The result supports strong thickness dependence but reports effective PFM response rather than direct pC/N charge.

source_candidates.title: Direct and converse piezoelectric responses at the nanoscale from epitaxial BiFeO3 thin films grown by polymer assisted deposition
source_candidates.independence_note: Method-comparison study with some shared DPFM expertise; retained as a boundary source, not independent replication.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Sixty nanometre epitaxial BiFeO3 film grown by polymer assisted deposition
source_candidates.method_scope: Direct DPFM and converse PFM applied to the same film system
source_candidates.reported_lead: Direct and converse results are reported separately as 22 pC/N and 17 pm/V.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Numerically similar values with dimensionally related units do not erase calibration, clamping, geometry, and method differences.

questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 系隧道结的电致电阻幅度在多大程度上由势垒厚度、掺杂、电极和器件尺寸决定？

source_candidates.title: Direct observation of room-temperature out-of-plane ferroelectricity and tunneling electroresistance at the two-dimensional limit
source_candidates.independence_note: Primary one-unit-cell tetragonal BFO tunnel-junction study.
source_candidates.sample_scope: One-unit-cell tetragonal BiFeO3 on SrRuO3 buffered SrTiO3 001
source_candidates.method_scope: PFM, KPFM, STEM and vertical tunnel-junction conductance measurements
source_candidates.reported_lead: Tunneling electroresistance reaches up to about 370 percent at room temperature.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The maximum is bound to the one-unit-cell device, resistance definition, writing pulse and readout bias.

source_candidates.title: Optically controlled electroresistance and electrically controlled photovoltage in ferroelectric tunnel junctions
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent device group using a Sm-substituted BFO barrier and semiconducting bottom electrode.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Three nanometre Sm0.1Bi0.9FeO3 barrier on niobium-doped SrTiO3 with platinum top electrode
source_candidates.method_scope: Electrical and optical modulation of ferroelectric tunnel-junction resistance
source_candidates.reported_lead: Off-on tunneling electroresistance ratio reaches about 100000 and is further light modulated.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Doping, a semiconducting depletion layer and illumination make the magnitude non-comparable to undoped one-cell BFO without regrouping.

source_candidates.title: Tunnel electroresistance in BiFeO3 junctions: size does matter
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent lateral-size study retained to expose incomplete polarization reversal as a device boundary.
source_candidates.sample_scope: BiFeO3 junctions with diameters from 1200 to 180 nm
source_candidates.method_scope: Polarization imaging, resistance switching and electric-field distribution modelling
source_candidates.reported_lead: Micrometre junctions reverse less than ten percent of their area while the smallest junctions approach complete reversal.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Observed electroresistance can be limited by lateral switching fraction and bottom-electrode resistance rather than barrier material alone.

questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 畴壁中的 EELS、HAADF 和电输运信号分别支持哪类缺陷解释，哪些样品条件会改变结论？

source_candidates.title: Domain-wall pinning and defect ordering in BiFeO3 probed on the atomic and nanoscale
source_candidates.independence_note: Primary quench-aging and ex-situ field study with paired STEM, EELS, PFM and c-AFM measurements.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Air-processed polycrystalline BiFeO3 in pristine, quenched and aged states
source_candidates.method_scope: Atomic-resolution HAADF-STEM, EELS, PFM and conductive AFM
source_candidates.reported_lead: Wall and domain EELS values, Bi-column intensity, wall thickness and conductive-wall fraction change with defect ordering.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: EELS separation, image intensity, inferred oxidation state and simulated vacancy fraction are separate observables and must not be collapsed.

source_candidates.title: Defect chemistry and electrical properties of BiFeO3
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent authors and macroscopic defect-chemistry route using conductivity and Seebeck measurements.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Undoped stoichiometric and calcium acceptor-doped BiFeO3 ceramics
source_candidates.method_scope: In-situ conductivity and Seebeck coefficient versus temperature and oxygen partial pressure
source_candidates.reported_lead: Undoped material shows mixed intrinsic electron-hole behavior, while calcium doping is mainly compensated by oxygen vacancies.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Macroscopic transport constrains defect models but does not independently reproduce atomic wall concentrations or EELS edge shifts.

source_candidates.title: Negatively Charged In-Plane and Out-Of-Plane Domain Walls with Oxygen-Vacancy Agglomerations in a Ca-Doped Bismuth-Ferrite Thin Film
source_candidates.independence_note: Different group, calcium-doped film, charged walls and oxygen-deficient planar defects define a deliberate boundary case.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Calcium-doped bismuth-ferrite thin film with charged in-plane and out-of-plane walls
source_candidates.method_scope: Atomic-resolution HAADF-STEM, EELS and charged-wall structural analysis
source_candidates.reported_lead: Oxygen-deficient planar defects coincide with negatively charged walls under the doped-film preparation route.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Oxygen-vacancy agglomeration in a calcium-doped charged wall cannot be generalized to undoped head-to-tail ceramic walls.

questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 的介电常数和损耗如何随频率、温度、测量方向及电极界面模型变化？

source_candidates.title: Highly 111-orientated BiFeO3 thin film deposited on La0.67Sr0.33MnO3 buffered Pt TiO2 SiO2 Si 100 substrate
source_candidates.independence_note: Primary combined ferroelectric, dielectric and fatigue report for one heterostructure.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Highly 111-oriented BiFeO3 on LSMO buffered platinum silicon stack
source_candidates.method_scope: Room-temperature capacitor dielectric and ferroelectric measurements
source_candidates.reported_lead: Relative permittivity about 116.8 and loss tangent about 2.7 percent at 1 kHz.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The values apply to the full film-electrode stack at the stated frequency and must not inherit the LSMO magnetic signal as intrinsic BFO.

source_candidates.title: Dielectric dynamics of epitaxial BiFeO3 thin films
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent epitaxial-film group using temperature sweeps and equivalent-circuit decomposition.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Epitaxial BiFeO3 films on niobium-doped SrTiO3
source_candidates.method_scope: Low-temperature dielectric spectroscopy with constant-phase-element circuit fitting
source_candidates.reported_lead: Fitted film-related dielectric constants exceed 400 at low temperature and a possible transition appears near 210 K.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Fitted constant-phase-element values are model-dependent and not directly interchangeable with a single-frequency raw capacitance-derived permittivity.

source_candidates.title: In-plane dielectric and magnetoelectric studies of BiFeO3
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent in-plane geometry and broad temperature-frequency sweep expose dispersion and interface-sensitive anomalies.
source_candidates.sample_scope: As-grown BiFeO3 thin film measured in an in-plane electrode geometry
source_candidates.method_scope: Frequency-dependent capacitance and loss versus temperature with repeated thermal cycles
source_candidates.reported_lead: Diffuse anomalies occur near 450 plus or minus 10 K and 550 K, with additional frequency-dependent low-temperature loss features.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: In-plane geometry, skin-layer effects, thermal cycling and dispersion prevent treatment as a universal room-temperature dielectric constant.
